Pre-Rolled Cones · Retail & Packaging

Pre-Rolled Cone Packaging for Different Retail Formats

JOJO can develop pre-rolled cone packaging around how the product needs to be sold: durable metal tins, rigid paper tubes, clear jars, individual and low-count packs, drawer boxes, hanging retail formats, premium presentation cartons and outer packaging.

Explore Packaging Formats Build Under Your Brand
Retail Unit→Display / Outer Pack→Master Packaging
Choose the Packaging Structure First

Different cone packs solve different retail jobs.

A low-count drawer box does not serve the same retail purpose as a metal tin, paper tube or large-count jar. Start by deciding the cone size, intended count and route to market. The packaging dimensions, internal arrangement, artwork and outer packaging can then be developed around that decision.

The images below are packaging concepts and development references. Counts, dimensions, slogans and statements visible inside concept artwork are not fixed specifications and should be confirmed for the final project.

01 — Pre-Rolled Cone Metal Tins

Metal Tin Packaging

Metal tins create a compact, durable retail pack and can be developed around different cone lengths, counts and brand positions. The footprint, depth and internal arrangement should be chosen around the selected cone before artwork is finalised.

How it works at retail Use tins when the individual pack should feel more permanent and presentation-led. A family of tin sizes can also support several cone SKUs while keeping one recognisable packaging language.
Develop custom pre-rolled cone tins →
01 / 03
02 — Pre-Rolled Cone Paper Tubes

Rigid Paper Tube Packaging

Rigid paper tubes offer a cylindrical packaging route that can scale in height and diameter. They can be developed as small-count or larger-count packs, with colour and print direction adapted to the brand.

How it works at retail The tube itself is the individual retail unit. Different heights and diameters can be used for different cone sizes or counts while maintaining a coordinated family.
Develop custom paper tube packaging →
01 / 02
03 — Pre-Rolled Cone Jar Packaging

Clear Plastic Jars for Larger Counts

Clear screw-lid jars offer a straightforward larger-count format where the product remains visible through the pack. Label design, jar dimensions and internal count can be developed around the final cone specification.

How it works at retail Useful when the buyer wants a larger-count retail or wholesale-style pack rather than a low-count individual box.
Develop custom cone jar packaging →
01 / 01
04 — Individual & Low-Count Cone Packs

Compact Retail Packaging for Pre-Rolled Cones

Low-count pre-rolled cone packaging can range from individual cone tubes to 3-piece drawer boxes and 6-piece carton formats. These packs are designed around portability, shelf footprint and the number of cones the buyer wants inside one retail unit.

How it works at retail Use this route when the individual retail pack needs to stay compact. The approved unit can later be grouped into a display box, hanging pack or larger outer carton.
Develop a low-count cone retail pack →
01 / 03
05 — Drawer Boxes & Premium Presentation Cartons

Premium Pre-Rolled Cone Retail Boxes

Drawer boxes and larger presentation cartons give more space to build a complete retail experience around the cone pack. They can accommodate the main cone product together with supporting pack components where required by the project.

How it works at retail The carton becomes the premium individual retail unit. Its internal layout, closure and printed panels should be resolved together before moving to dieline and production artwork.
Develop premium pre-rolled cone boxes →
01 / 04
06 — Hanging Pre-Rolled Cone Packaging

Peg-Ready Hanging Retail Packs

A hanging pack creates another route to shelf by using vertical peg or hook space. The front can focus on the product presentation while the back carries the information architecture needed for retail.

How it works at retail Useful for retailers that merchandise small packaged products vertically. The hanging structure should be developed around the selected cone size, count and visibility requirement.
Develop hanging cone retail packaging →
01 / 01
07 — Outer & Master Packaging

Build the Packaging Hierarchy Beyond the Individual Pack

Once the individual retail format is approved, larger grouped cartons and master packaging can be developed around it. This keeps the consumer-facing pack, retailer-facing group pack and distribution layer connected.

How it works at retail Individual retail pack → grouped retail / display carton → outer or master packaging. Final quantities and carton dimensions should follow the approved retail unit.
Develop outer and master packaging →

FAQ · Pre-Rolled Cone Packaging

Common questions before packaging development.

What packaging formats can JOJO develop for pre-rolled cones?

JOJO can develop retail concepts using metal tins, rigid paper tubes, clear plastic jars, individual cone tubes, low-count cartons, drawer boxes, hanging packs, premium presentation cartons and corresponding outer or master packaging.

Can pre-rolled cone packaging be developed in different sizes?

Yes. The packaging structure can be adapted around the selected cone size and planned retail count. Final dimensions should be confirmed after the cone format and internal arrangement are approved.

Can JOJO develop custom metal tins for pre-rolled cones?

Yes. Metal tin concepts can be developed in different footprints, depths, colours and artwork directions depending on the selected cone size, count and retail position.

Can pre-rolled cones be packed in paper tubes or jars?

Yes. Rigid paper tubes can be developed for different cone lengths and counts, while clear plastic jars can be used for larger-count retail or wholesale-style presentation.

Can JOJO develop low-count retail boxes for cones?

Yes. Low-count concepts can include individual cone tubes, small drawer boxes, 6-piece carton formats and other compact retail structures developed around the project brief.

Can retail packs be supplied with outer or master packaging?

Yes. Once the individual retail unit is approved, corresponding display, outer or master packaging can be developed around the final dimensions and pack count.

Can these packaging concepts be developed under a private label?

Yes. The retail format can be taken into the JOJO Private Label & OEM process to define cone size, paper, colour, filter tip, branding, artwork and final packaging under the buyer's brand.

Retail Packaging → Private Label & OEM

Found a packaging direction that fits your market?

Take the selected format into the JOJO Private Label & OEM process to define cone size, paper base, paper colour, filter tip, tip branding, artwork, retail packaging and outer pack.
